test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Five bells commence tolling together and toll at intervals of 5, 10, 15, 20 and 25 seconds respectively. In 1 hour 20 minutes, how many times do they toll together?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**LCM** of 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 = 300 seconds.

Interval of tolling together = 300 ÷ 60 = 5 minutes.

Total time = 1 hour 20 minutes = 80 minutes.

Number of times = (Total time ÷ Interval) + 1 = (80 ÷ 5) + 1 = 16 + 1 = 17.

**∴ The correct answer is 17 times.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Intervals are 5, 10, 15, 20, and 25 seconds. Total duration is 1 hour 20 minutes.

**Formula Used:** Time interval for together tolling = **LCM** of individual intervals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be276615019a945f45a83116c7a38deacf256ccd9a431f5cd61fe6598e08eca1.png] 

⇒ **LCM** (5, 10, 15, 20, 25):

⇒ 5 = 5¹

⇒ 10 = 2 × 5

⇒ 15 = 3 × 5

⇒ 20 = 2² × 5

⇒ 25 = 5²

⇒ **LCM** = 2² × 3 × 5² = 4 × 3 × 25 = 300 seconds.

⇒ Interval in minutes = 300 ÷ 60 = 5 minutes.

⇒ Total time in minutes = (1 × 60) + 20 = 80 minutes.

⇒ Number of times = (80 ÷ 5) + 1 = 16 + 1 = 17 times.

**∴ The correct answer is 17 times.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM (Least Common Multiple)

It is the smallest non-zero common number which is a multiple of all the given numbers.

Tolling Together Rule

For problems starting with 'commence tolling together', always add 1 to the quotient of (Total Time / LCM) to account for the first toll at 0 seconds.

Time Conversions

1 hour = 60 minutes = 3600 seconds. Always ensure units are consistent before performing division.</p
